title: 🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE WISE AND FOOLISH BUILDERS – IS YOUR LIFE BUILT ON THE ROCK? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE PARABLE OF THE WISE AND FOOLISH BUILDERS – IS YOUR LIFE BUILT ON THE ROCK? 🔥
📖 Matthew 7:24-27 – "Therefore everyone who hears these words of Mine and puts them into practice is like a wise man who built his house on the rock. The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house; yet it did not fall, because it had its foundation on the rock. But everyone who hears these words of Mine and does not put them into practice is like a foolish man who built his house on sand. The rain came down, the streams rose, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell with a great crash."

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what did Jesus mean in the Parable of the Wise and Foolish Builders? What is the ‘rock’ and how do I know if my life is built on it?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people call themselves Christians, but when trials come, their faith collapses. Why? Because they were never built on the ROCK!
🚨 Today, we will uncover the powerful meaning of this parable and why your entire eternity depends on what foundation you are standing on!
⚠️ WARNING: If your life is built on the wrong foundation, disaster is coming!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES THE PARABLE MEAN?
📖 Luke 6:47-48 – "As for everyone who comes to Me and hears My words and puts them into practice, I will show you what they are like. They are like a man building a house, who dug down deep and laid the foundation on rock. When a flood came, the torrent struck that house but could not shake it, because it was well built."
🔥 JESUS COMPARES TWO TYPES OF PEOPLE:

✔️ THE WISE BUILDER – Hears the Word of God and OBEYS it.
✔️ THE FOOLISH BUILDER – Hears the Word but IGNORES it.
💡 The FOUNDATION represents what you build your life on.
🚨 If you are not built on the right foundation, you will collapse in times of trouble!
💡 Are you a wise or a foolish builder?

🔥 2. WHAT DOES THE "ROCK" REPRESENT?
📖 1 Corinthians 3:11 – "For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ."
🔥 THE ROCK REPRESENTS:

✔️ JESUS CHRIST! (Psalm 18:2, 1 Corinthians 10:4)
✔️ OBEDIENCE TO GOD’S WORD! (James 1:22-25)
✔️ A STRONG, UNMOVABLE FAITH! (Matthew 16:18)
💡 A life built on Jesus and obedience to His Word will NEVER fall!
🚀 BUT IF YOU BUILD ON ANYTHING ELSE—YOU ARE HEADED FOR DISASTER!

🔥 3. WHAT DOES THE "SAND" REPRESENT?
📖 Proverbs 14:12 – "There is a way that appears to be right, but in the end, it leads to death."
🔥 THE SAND REPRESENTS:

❌ Worldly success and riches. (Mark 8:36)
❌ False teachings and man-made religion. (Colossians 2:8)
❌ Feelings-based Christianity. (Jeremiah 17:9)
❌ A life of sin and compromise. (Galatians 5:19-21)
🚨 If your foundation is weak, when the storms of life hit, your faith will CRUMBLE!
💡 Are you standing on the Rock, or sinking in the sand?

🔥 4. STORMS WILL COME – WHAT WILL HAPPEN TO YOUR HOUSE?
📖 John 16:33 – "In this world, you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world."
🔥 THE STORMS REPRESENT:

✔️ Trials and suffering. (James 1:2-4)
✔️ Persecution for your faith. (2 Timothy 3:12)
✔️ Spiritual attacks from the enemy. (Ephesians 6:12)
🚨 If your faith is weak, these storms will WIPE YOU OUT!
🔥 BUT IF YOU ARE BUILT ON CHRIST, YOU WILL STAND STRONG!
💡 WHAT FOUNDATION WILL YOU STAND ON WHEN THE STORM COMES?

🔥 5. HOW TO BUILD YOUR LIFE ON THE ROCK!
📖 James 1:22 – "Do not merely listen to the word, and so deceive yourselves. Do what it says."
🔥 STEPS TO BUILD ON THE ROCK:

✔️ SURRENDER TO JESUS CHRIST AS LORD! (Romans 10:9-10)
✔️ READ AND OBEY GOD’S WORD DAILY! (Psalm 119:105)
✔️ LIVE IN HOLINESS AND REPENTANCE! (2 Corinthians 7:1)
✔️ PRAY AND SEEK GOD CONTINUALLY! (1 Thessalonians 5:16-18)
✔️ STAND FIRM IN TRIALS! (1 Peter 5:8-10)
🚨 DON’T JUST HEAR THE WORD—OBEY IT!
💡 ARE YOU BUILDING YOUR LIFE ON THE ROCK OR ON THE SAND?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CHOOSE YOUR FOUNDATION WISELY!
📖 Deuteronomy 30:19 – "I have set before you life and death, blessings and curses. Now choose life, so that you and your children may live."

🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?
❌ A weak foundation that will crumble in the storm?
✔️ A strong foundation built on Jesus Christ that will NEVER fail?
🚨 THE TIME TO CHOOSE IS NOW—TOMORROW IS NOT GUARANTEED!
💡 WILL YOU STAND STRONG, OR WILL YOU FALL?

🙏 PRAYER TO BUILD YOUR LIFE ON JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I want to build my life on You, the solid Rock. Forgive me for trusting in worldly things. Teach me to obey Your Word and follow You completely. Strengthen my faith so I can stand firm in every storm. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
